capture-verification.json.note: Each process builds every observation it would skip, fails the game on any disagreement and reports confirmed skips on stderr at powers of ten. The host process is the embedded engine (none for the cold backend, whose game processes log separately); other processes are cold game processes and vcmireplay. The stalled poison game stops early by design. Every run passed.

codec.json.note: Socket transfer itself is not included; the cold reader thread decodes concurrently with the engine.
